disclosure: Existing FloorItem radii and VisualItem activation/radii; existing controlled ItemPresentationState unchanged. No undisclosed emitter enumeration.
shader: Circular XZ source receiving radiance in Godot; original environment RG16BE depth and octahedral BA normals; native authored DirectionalLight3D; no constant base emission in live scene.
source_units: One cell=5ft. Backend bright and bright+dim outer radius floor to integer cells with minimum1; very-bright is fractional feet/5.

optical_conventions.falloff: Continuous smoothstep bands through backend very-bright/bright/outer anchors, zero at outer radius; collapsed bands taper across their remaining radius.
optical_conventions.fixture_energy: Original torch.flame image luminance, normalized to clip mean and bounded 0.85-1.15; interpolated on the same native display clock. Backend activation/range unchanged.
optical_conventions.architecture: Walls and doors opt into abs(N dot L) for two-sided isometric readability, before alpha. Other receivers stay one-sided.

limits: Ordinary optical wall occlusion is not reproduced: the SDK does not disclose per-source affected_tiles; transparent sprite quads do not cast equivalent shadows. Backend visibility remains authoritative.
Private noncontrolled inventory and standalone spell/contribution emitters are not disclosed as light sources and are not inferred from tile brightness.
Current modular runtime illumination uses flat billboard receivers; the newly supplied one-outfit experimental depth/normal delivery is available but not adopted.
Source lift, neutral colour and smooth radial radiance gains are explicit optical conventions; emitter sockets/heights/hues/intensity are not authored or disclosed.
The shader loops disclosed source count per fragment; 25-source correctness is tested, not large-map lighting performance.

Original live screenshot timings include startup and capture waits; controlled recorded playback, settled and zoom40 measurements are in generated/render_repair_validation.json, not a large-map benchmark.
